params.cutoff_rule: cutoff = barClose - 4h; latest kept point must have timestamp == cutoff
params.declared_proxy: the ratio values are synthetic; the fixture pins the arithmetic only

skip_reasons.ratio_stale: no point, or the latest kept point is not exactly at the cutoff
skip_reasons.ratio_incomplete: fewer than 180 kept points, a non-finite or non-positive ratio in the last 180, or a step other than 4h in the last 180
